title: Variations on a circular Hessenberg pair
summary: A square matrix is called Hessenberg whenever each entry below the subdiagonal is zero and each entry on the subdiagonal is nonzero. A Hessenberg pair is an ordered pair of diagonalizable linear maps on a nonzero finite-dimensional vector space, that each act on an eigenbasis of the other one in a Hessenberg fashion. A Hessenberg system $Φ$ an `oriented' version of a Hessenberg pair. It is known that $Φ$ is determined up to isomorphism by its parameter array; this consists of the eigenvalue sequence of $Φ$, the dual eigenvalue sequence of $Φ$, and a sequence of nonzero scalars…
